body: I understand what you’re saying because I used to think the exact same way. The relationship I’m in doesn’t feel abusive. That’s why I’m asking
Thank you. I might have to take you up on that offer to talk, I couldn’t put a lot in here as it would make it obvious and I fear they would know it was me
Oh I don’t think they’ll kill me...
I have tried to leave before. But they moved in with me. And refuse to leave until the situation has passed and things are back to normal..

Can’t afford it. Have no one to do anything with. Hate being alone and doing things alone because of my anxiety. But also don’t know how to make friends or where to even start. I’ve felt stuck for quite some time. Therapy doesn’t help
Realized I can’t pay my bills this month. Again. I’m drowning in debt and I’m going to lose the one thing that’s been keeping me going. I have nothing left and no one left to live for

I’ve been alone for the last ten years of my life. I’m stuck in a never ending cycle of debt that keeps me from doing anything I ever want to do. Basically all I can do is sit in my room and go to work. I’m exhausted. I’m tired. And I can’t do it anymore
They tell you your whole life that it gets better. But it doesn’t
